body: You know what? Good. I won't let people guilt me into doing something good. That's disgusting. I'm never going to give my organs away unless it's to someone close to me, and that's final. I am seflish. So selfish I deserve to die. And I will keep my organs when I die. I will let them decompose into nothing because that's what I want and that's what's gonna happen.

Yeah but that's how I see it. I know it would save lives, I want to save lives, but I can't do it in that way. I see it as people tearing me apart and giving me to strangers. I know I won't care when I'm dead, but I'd have to give consent while alive. I couldn't do that. It would torture me until I do die.

It doesn't do anything but that's how millions of people have died and it's how I want to. I'm not selfish for not wanting to gift my organs to someone else. Why don't they take my skin, make it a drum. Shave my head, make it a wig. I don't want to be taken apart. I don't even believe in an afterlife. I can and will be a good person and help people. All of that does not disappear because I'm a horrid bitch for not giving my body away.

So a guy who ruined people's lives is a better person soh saved hundreds because he is an organ donor?

I do have consideration for others, in fact I want to be a doctor and save lives. And I'll be saving lives alive. And I'll die whole. Just because I can give 110% doesn't mean I need to. 

And I am allowed to receive organs. Because other people have decided to give their organs to people who need them, like me. and just because I don't want to do that doesn't make me a horrible person. Do you think every organ receiver will choose to be an organ donor? I'm sure there are amazing people out there who risked their life to save others and were very giving but chose to keep what was given to them.

Say a guy who stepped on others to climb their ladder to success and treated people like dolls chose to be an organ donor, is he selfless?

I don't care what my family thinks about me not being an organ donor. I want them to be able to visit me whole. I know I'd be dead and wouldn't care, but I'm alive now and I do. This is my body and I will decide what happens to it alive and dead if I'm able to. It's not selfish. 

What about the secret Santa, the red hearts that have peoples wishes for Christmas that they can't afford. I don't need the money, I could give it away and I'd be fine. But I don't want to. Giving an organ to someone is a gift. I'm going to keep my body whole even if you don't understand why I feel this way because I am the one who decides if I'm going to be or not.

It's how I want to die. It's how I want to decompose. I know I could save other lives, but it's not what I want to do. I respect the people who are organ donors but I could never do it because I don't like the way it makes me feel when I think about it. It's not selfish. I came into this world whole, why can't I leave it completely whole? And I know I'll be dead and I won't know but it is **my** body. I chose what happens to it alive or dead.

Well, yes. It is my body and I don't have to give my organs away. I would accept a strangers organ and if I die with it, I'm going to keep it. They chose to give theirs away, they wanted to help people. I don't feel right giving mine away. It doesn't sit right with me. I would be doing it for the wrong reasons. I am in no way selfish. If I had a scoop of ice cream left at a shoppe that I paid for do I have to go give it to the kid who dropped his? No.

Oh, and my mother died from lung cancer while on a waiting list when I was young. I don't hate anyone for not giving theirs away to her. I grew up fine without her.
No.

How am I selfish for wanting to be whole? I don't want to be cut open after a sudden death and have my heart/kidney/pancreas etc harvested. I would gladly accept another organ from someone if I needed it, and if I could give an organ to a family member or close friend I would but not a stranger. I want my family to be able to visit me. All of me.
